description: Describes how an output column of a defining-SQL object derives from its immediate input column(s). Used by column provenance to classify a column so a policy layer (e.g. quasi-identifier enforcement) can reason about it without re-translating SQL.
name: DerivationKind

enum.name: IDENTITY
enum.description: A bare column reference or a pure alias: the output value is exactly the input value.

enum.name: AGGREGATE
enum.description: A set function over the input (e.g. COUNT, MAX, SUM). The specific SetFunctionType is carried separately.

enum.name: EXPRESSION
enum.description: An arithmetic, string, CASE, CAST, or other non-aggregate function over one or more inputs.

enum.name: LITERAL
enum.description: A constant value with no input columns.
